marta_sales: Handover: TerraBloom (trial -> pilot). ARR motion ~ $85k ARR if pilot converts. Pilot end 2026-04-15. Key asks: p50 <100ms for short generative responses in EU-north (Stockholm), SCIM SSO via Okta, audit logs for 1 year, and a whitelist for a handful of IPs. Theyre testing 'redwood-lite' (v2.0) and hit 429s during a scripted demo. Renewal will be at risk if latency or auth gaps persist. Deal notes: https://crm.example/DEAL-5911

marie_se: Thanks for the context. TerraBloom uses multi-step output: unpack doc -> call internal sanitizer -> format YAML. Theyre sensitive to tool-call latency and want determinism in outputs. I can help validate acceptance criteria during staging.

liam_cs: Taking ownership. Oz, can you lead infra validation and perf runs? Dina please own support runbook & on-call mapping.

oz_cs_eng: On it. Quick Q: expected peak concurrent interactive sessions? Also any KV-cache reuse?

marta_sales: Peak interactive sessions ~ 10 concurrent, average prompt 80 tokens in, 180 tokens out. KV reuse moderate (some repeated templates). Demo load peaked at ~120 req/min.

carl_eng: Engineering note: 10 concurrent with 180 tokens out implies sustained token throughput ~30k tokens/min. For p50 <100ms we should consider A100 small-format or quantized T4 fleet depending on cost. Need exact burst profile and acceptance SLA.

liam_cs: Noted. I'll gather exemplar prompts for regression tests. Please include tool-call scenarios.

marta_sales: Example prompts (paste below) 1) Summarize SOP and extract steps with owners as YAML only. 2) Given customer template, replace placeholders with company names and return validated YAML. They expect strict format.
